description: REFERENCE KG state after building the D1 (USGS Earthquakes) catalog. Mirrors what an attendee's domain KG looks like once the D1 foot-gun nodes + shared story-map node are proposed and accepted. NOT committed to the public workshop repo (which stays root-only).

data.title: Domain Knowledge Root
data.description: Root of the domain (geospatial / catalog-app) knowledge tree.

data.title: USGS quake time is epoch milliseconds
data.description: properties.time and properties.updated are Unix epoch milliseconds (not seconds, not ISO 8601). Pass straight to new Date(ms); do NOT multiply/divide by 1000.

data.title: GeoJSON coordinates are lon, lat, depth
data.description: geometry.coordinates = [longitude, latitude, depth_km] — longitude first. Older entries may be 2-tuples; pad to 3 with depth=null. Leaflet wants [lat, lon] — swap order.

data.title: USGS quake feed has many nullable fields
data.description: felt, cdi, mmi, tsunami, alert are frequently null; mag can be null/negative. Do not crash on null. properties.place is free human text, parse-hostile.

data.title: Story map must answer four viewer questions at a glance
data.description: After data loads, plain-language answers: where from, what it is, how to reuse, what is on screen now — not just JSON paths.
